Back Alley Suprise
Sep 2022 • Solo
Nestled in the back alley of shophouses directly behind the famous Benh Thanh market is this little restaurant away from the Main Street.
As you walk into the alley, you’ll see nail salons on both sides and 2 signages above. Walk past the signage’s and it opens up into an empty space with a few restaurants and on the extreme left is where you will find this restaurant.
Menu is simple but taste really good especially with the different types on Bun (fresh Vietnamese noodles).
I highly recommend the Noodles with baby clams, this is not as common as the typical fresh noodles with grilled meat but the taste is awesome especially when you squeeze fresh lime over the noodle and mix well. 
The nuts in the noodle adds crunch and texture to the dish. It is served with a small bowl of clam broth which is very nice as well

Back to our favourite in HCMC
Mar 2019 • Couples
We ate dinner at this restaurant 3 times on our previous visit to HCMC and this time again we went there 3 times for dinner! And we enjoyed all the meals, having 6 different dishes in all. All freshly cooked with well-balanced flavours and very good value for money. Note they serve pork, beef, seafood but not chicken.

This restaurant is very tucked away and is very busy with local people, but few tourists. Maybe that is why the manager remembered us from 2 years ago. He even remembered where we live! In fact all the staff are friendly and helpful. After each meal we were served with a local dessert - a lovely gesture of hospitality.
